items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 14 May 2026 5:05am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 14 May 2026 at 5:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic, and low pressure over Scandinavia, with various troughs affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

North or Northwest 5 or 6, increasing occasionally 7 for a time in the west this afternoon & evening, but remaining 4 or 5 in the east of the area throughout the period.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional showers, becoming mainly fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or North-Northwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the west at first, decreasing Northwest 3 to 5 this afternoon, then backing West or Northwest 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
